from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FiscalData(BaseModel):
    """A single financial data point from a quarterly report: period date and amount."""
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of this reporting period (e.g., '2021-03-31', '2022-12-31')")
    period_label: str | None = Field(description="Label for this period as written (e.g., '本报告期末', '上年度末', '2021年末')")
    total_liabilities_and_equity: str | None = Field(description="Total liabilities and owners' equity amount as reported (e.g., '55,769,965,522.68')")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g., '元')")
    report_period_name: str | None = Field(description="Which financial report this comes from (e.g., '2021年第一季度财务报告')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Brief excerpt or table reference anchoring the data point")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    fiscal_data_points: list[FiscalData]
